name: Love in Ardennes
source:
Spring 2024. Clara is a highschooler who works well but doesn't have any boyfriend to the great displeasure of her best friend Rebecca.

Follow this teenager's peaceful life until she falls in love for Logan, a young thug of Charleville-Mézières, France.

[From [url=https://fflo.itch.io/love-in-ardennes]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2024年春天。克拉拉是一名高中生，工作成绩很好，但没有男朋友，这让她最好的朋友丽贝卡非常不满。

跟随这个少年平静的生活，直到她爱上法国沙勒维尔梅济耶尔的年轻暴徒洛根。

[来自[url=https://fflo.itch.io/love-in-ardennes]itch.io[/url]]
